text: TWG Global is a privately held US investment firm (Mark Walter, Todd Boehly) and also owner of the Cadillac F1 team; no state shareholder. A 2026 class action against Walter is corporate, not a rights finding.
short: TWG Global is a privately held US investment firm (Mark Walter, Todd Boehly) and also owner of the Cadillac F1 team; no state shareholder.

source.name: Motorsport.com - Cadillac F1 owners Mark Walter and TWG Global face class-action lawsuit
source.quote: TWG Global plays a vital role in Cadillac F1's organisational structure, acting as both an investing partner and an operational entity for the team.
